chunks: And We made his progeny the survivors.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'survivors' mentioned in Surah As-Saffat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited as proof of the 'Baqa' (permanence) of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that divine guidance remains intact through the specific lineage of the Prophet and the Imams. It underscores the theological concept that while other nations perished, the spiritual and physical continuity of the chosen family ensures the preservation of truth until the Day of Judgment.
